# Leading the future of global agriculture

Nutrien is a leading global provider of crop inputs and services. We operate a world-class network
of production, distribution and ag retail facilities that positions us to efficiently serve the
needs of farmers. We focus on creating long-term value by prioritizing investments that strengthen
the advantages of our business across the ag value chain and by maintaining access to the resources
and relationships with stakeholders needed to achieve our goals.

### 25,1000

employees

### >50>0

countries served by our products and services

### $19M$0M

USD invested in the communities where we operate

What we do

## Production. Distribution. Retail. Support.

Nutrien’s world-class upstream and midstream network produces and distributes 27.5 million tonnes of
potash, nitrogen and phosphate products. Our downstream Retail business serves farmers in key
agricultural markets in North America, Australia and South America.

[Our business][52]
Investors

## In the business of creating value

We prioritize investments that strengthen the advantages of our business across the ag value chain
and return meaningful capital to our shareholders.

# Advancing innovation in agriculture for a sustainable future

As a global advocate for the plant science industry, CropLife International champions innovative
technologies that enable farmers to sustainably increase productivity while managing the critical
challenges facing our climate and the environment.

[

## Ministers urged to prioritize rules-based trade for innovative agricultural systems at World
## Trade Organization MC14

## 11 global associations publish open letter

Download ][28] [

Download ][29]

### The challenge

As our global population grows to an expected 9 billion by 2050, the future of humanity will depend
on our ability to address our most basic need – food.

### Our approach

By uniting diverse partners around common goals, CropLife International takes concrete actions to
help farmers grow more food on less land sustainably.

## Our Ambitions

Together, we can drive actionable progress.

### Increasing Food Security

Improving agricultural productivity and efficiency.

[ Increasing Food Security ][30]

### Tackling Climate Change

Reducing emissions and increasing carbon sequestration.

[ Tackling Climate Change ][31]

### Protecting Biodiversity

Safeguarding ecosystems that support biological diversity

[ Protecting Biodiversity ][32]

## Our Work

We enable innovation by advocating for trade and regulatory policies that give farmers access to the
technologies required to meet these challenges. This includes ensuring the responsible and safe use
of plant science innovations.

# Advancing innovation in agriculture for a sustainable future

As a global advocate for the plant science industry, CropLife International champions innovative
technologies that enable farmers to sustainably increase productivity while managing the critical
challenges facing our climate and the environment.

### The challenge

As our global population grows to an expected 9 billion by 2050, the future of humanity will depend
on our ability to address our most basic need – food.

### Our approach

By uniting diverse partners around common goals, CropLife International takes concrete actions to
help farmers grow more food on less land sustainably.

## Our Ambitions

Together, we can drive actionable progress.

### Increasing Food Security

Improving agricultural productivity and efficiency.

[ Increasing Food Security ][30]

### Tackling Climate Change

Reducing emissions and increasing carbon sequestration.

[ Tackling Climate Change ][31]

### Protecting Biodiversity

Safeguarding ecosystems that support biological diversity

[ Protecting Biodiversity ][32]

## Our Work

We enable innovation by advocating for trade and regulatory policies that give farmers access to the
technologies required to meet these challenges. This includes ensuring the responsible and safe use
of plant science innovations.

## Featured Resources

Case Study

### 2026 Time and Cost of New Agrochemical Product Discovery, Development and Registration

A new agrochemical active ingredient now requires an average of $307 million and more than 11 years
to move from discovery to commercial launch, reflecting the growing scientific, regulatory, and
stewardship demands of modern crop protection innovation.

[ Download the 2026 Time and Cost of New Agrochemical Product Discovery, Development and
Registration ][37]
Guidance

### Croplife International Recommendations To 14th WTO Ministerial Conference Negotiators

CropLife International urges science-based trade, strong IP protections, and innovation to
strengthen global food security.

[ Download the Croplife International Recommendations To 14th WTO Ministerial Conference Negotiators
][38]
Case Study

### A Practical Guide to Sustainable Agricultural Growth: Success Stories From Around the World

This global report showcases real-world examples of how farmers, innovators, and policymakers are
transforming agriculture to deliver higher yields, healthier soils, and stronger rural economies
while reducing environmental impact. From Brazil’s land restoration and India’s water-saving rice
systems to Kenya’s pest-management strategies and Ghana’s professionalized farm services, these
success stories prove that sustainable, inclusive agricultural growth is both achievable and
scalable.

[ Download the A Practical Guide to Sustainable Agricultural Growth: Success Stories From Around the
World ][39]
Document

### International Code of Conduct on Pesticide Management: Guide for Industry

The "Industry Guide for the International Code of Conduct on Pesticide Management" by CropLife
International provides comprehensive guidelines for responsible pesticide use and management. This
guide aligns with global standards, emphasizing safe practices, environmental protection, and risk
minimization across the pesticide lifecycle. Essential for industry stakeholders, it supports
adherence to international best practices and promotes sustainable, safe agricultural production.

# Leading the Future of Agriculture

Helena Agri-Enterprises is one of the nation’s foremost agronomic providers of crop inputs,
application technology, manufacturing and data solutions. For nearly 70 years, our people have been
driven to providing sustainable solutions that help feed, clothe and fuel the world.

[Our Company][61]

## Our Expertise

Helena is a global leader in developing and manufacturing products for the agriculture, turf and
ornamental industry. These inputs are strengthened by our decades-long experience in precision
technology and data management. Explore our products and services to find the right fit for your
unique operation.

[Our Expertise][62]

[Helena Pillars]

## Our Advantage

Grounded by tradition yet empowered by innovation, Helena combines the power of relationships with
forward-thinking ideas. We work alongside our customers to meet evolving agronomic needs by
discovering and implementing new technology. Learn how we’re impacting agriculture and specialty
markets now and in the future.

[Our Advantage][63]

## Sustainability

At Helena Agri-Enterprises, sustainability drives everything we do. Guided by three pillars —
People, Products, and Knowledge — we focus on reducing greenhouse gas emissions, supporting the
United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals, and fostering a culture of respect and opportunity.
Discover exactly how Helena is shaping a more sustainable future for agriculture and the communities
we serve.

[Sustainability][64]

## Stay in touch

Subscribe to Helena communications and receive the latest news and information impacting your
business.

[Subscribe][65]

# Leading the Future of Agriculture

Helena Agri-Enterprises is one of the nation’s foremost agronomic providers of crop inputs,
application technology, manufacturing and data solutions. For nearly 70 years, our people have been
driven to providing sustainable solutions that help feed, clothe and fuel the world.

[Our Company][61]

## Our Expertise

Helena is a global leader in developing and manufacturing products for the agriculture, turf and
ornamental industry. These inputs are strengthened by our decades-long experience in precision
technology and data management. Explore our products and services to find the right fit for your
unique operation.

[Our Expertise][62]

[Helena Pillars]

## Our Advantage

Grounded by tradition yet empowered by innovation, Helena combines the power of relationships with
forward-thinking ideas. We work alongside our customers to meet evolving agronomic needs by
discovering and implementing new technology. Learn how we’re impacting agriculture and specialty
markets now and in the future.

[Our Advantage][63]

## Sustainability

At Helena Agri-Enterprises, sustainability drives everything we do. Guided by three pillars —
People, Products, and Knowledge — we focus on reducing greenhouse gas emissions, supporting the
United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals, and fostering a culture of respect and opportunity.
Discover exactly how Helena is shaping a more sustainable future for agriculture and the communities
we serve.

[Sustainability][64]

## Stay in touch

Subscribe to Helena communications and receive the latest news and information impacting your
business.

[Subscribe][65]

Nutrien is a leading global provider of crop inputs and services. We operate a world-class network
of production, distribution and ag retail facilities that positions us to efficiently serve the
needs of farmers. We focus on creating long-term value by prioritizing investments that strengthen
the advantages of our business across the ag value chain and by maintaining access to the resources

# Yara is a global leader in crop nutrition, ammonia and essential industrial solutions

Yara's mission is to responsibly feed the world and protect the planet. We are working to
decarbonize food, shipping and other energy-intensive industries.

Yara agronomist checking crop quality Yara agronomist checking crop quality

 

 

 

 

## Crop nutrition

We deliver complete crop nutrition solutions for the farming community and the food value chain.

[Go to Crop nutrition][130]

Production plant worker biking Production plant worker biking

 

 

 

 

## Industrial Solutions

We provide nitrogen-based solutions and services across a wide range of industries.

[Go to Industrial solutions][131]

## Yara Clean Ammonia

We are uniquely positioned to enable the hydrogen economy in a market expected to grow in the next
decades.

# ***Product Category***

[
[ico][Glufosinate-ammonium2n8]

### Plant Growth Regulator

Plant growth regulators are a class of chemical substances that can regulate the growth and
development of plants, and can significantly affect the physiological processes of rooting,
flowering, fruiting and so on through micro-application.

][228]
[
[ico][Glyphosate (1)0n2]

### Insecticide

Insecticides are a class of chemical or biological agents used to kill or control pest populations,
with the aim of protecting crops, forests, food storage and public health environments from pests,
thereby increasing agricultural yields and safeguarding human health. They act in a variety of ways
on the nervous system, growth and development, or other physiological functions of insects to
control pests.

][229]
[
[ico][Indoxacar (6)oht]

### Herbicide

Herbicides are products that help you effectively remove weeds from your fields, targeting and
suppressing weed growth without damaging your crops, ensuring your crops receive adequate nutrients
and water to boost yield and quality. Suitable for a wide range of growing environments, it is easy
to use and highly effective. Divided into selective and non-selective types to meet different needs.

][230]
[
[ico][Mancozebsik]

### Fungicide

Fungicides are products that protect crops from fungi and bacteria, effectively preventing and
controlling diseases, ensuring healthy crop growth and increasing yields. Suitable for a wide range
of crops, easy to use and effective.

][231]
[
[ico][spinosad2xwe]

### Complex Formula

Complex formulation fungicides contain multiple active ingredients that target different fungi and
bacteria to provide broad-spectrum protection. Prevents and controls diseases through multiple
mechanisms of action, reducing the risk of resistance and ensuring crop health. Suitable for a wide
range of crops and easy to use.

### Plant Growth Regulator

Plant growth regulators are a class of chemical substances that can regulate the growth and
development of plants, and can significantly affect the physiological processes of rooting,
flowering, fruiting and so on through micro-application.

[ico][Glyphosate (1)0n2]

### Insecticide

Insecticides are a class of chemical or biological agents used to kill or control pest populations,
with the aim of protecting crops, forests, food storage and public health environments from pests,
thereby increasing agricultural yields and safeguarding human health. They act in a variety of ways
on the nervous system, growth and development, or other physiological functions of insects to
control pests.

### Herbicide

Herbicides are products that help you effectively remove weeds from your fields, targeting and
suppressing weed growth without damaging your crops, ensuring your crops receive adequate nutrients
and water to boost yield and quality. Suitable for a wide range of growing environments, it is easy
to use and highly effective. Divided into selective and non-selective types to meet different needs.

controlling diseases, ensuring healthy crop growth and increasing yields. Suitable for a wide range
of crops, easy to use and effective.

mechanisms of action, reducing the risk of resistance and ensuring crop health. Suitable for a wide
range of crops and easy to use.

## Industries

### Dairy Manufacturing

As experts in the dairy sector, AsureQuality offers specialised testing, auditing, and certification
services to ensure product safety, quality, regulatory compliance, and global market access for
dairy manufacturers.


[Learn more][71]

### Food Manufacturing

AsureQuality supports food manufacturers with testing, auditing, and certification services to
ensure food safety, quality, compliance, and market access both locally and globally.

[Learn more][72]

### Horticulture

AsureQuality provides testing, auditing, and certification services to the horticulture sector,
ensuring food safety, quality, and compliance with global standards, including residue testing, farm
audits, and GlobalG.A.P. certification.

[Learn more][73]

### Pharmaceutical

We provide comprehensive GMP testing services to the pharmaceutical. nutraceutical and medicinal
cannabis industries at our Medsafe Certified laboratories.

[Learn more][74]

### Meat Processing

Working alongside partners at Aotearoa's meat processing plants to enhance all aspects of the value
chain to ensure animal products meet the highest global standards of quality. 

[Learn more][75]

### Seeds

With a personal sense of commitment and connection we are proud to serve the grain and seed
industry. Offering a full spectrum of services of the highest integrity.

[Learn more][76]

### Apiculture

Helping the apiary industry through providing essential services. We help protect and enhance the
health of bees and quality of honey. 

[Learn more][77]

# Database of the Safety and Benefits of Biotechnology

Welcome to the CropLife International database of published papers and reviews demonstrating the
benefits and safety implications associated with the use of agricultural biotechnology products.

In 2018, 26 countries grew 191.7 million hectares of biotech crops – an increase of 1.9 million
hectares from 2017. The average biotech crop adoption rate in the top five biotech crop-growing
countries increased in 2018 to reach close to saturation, with USA at 93.3% (average for soybeans,
maize, and canola adoption), Brazil (93%), Argentina (~100%), Canada (92.5%), and India (95%).
Future expansion of biotech crop areas in these countries would be through immediate approval and
commercialization of new biotech crops and traits to target problems related to climate change and
the emergence of new pests and diseases.

Biotech crops however have already expanded beyond the big four (maize, soybeans, cotton, and
canola) to give more choices for many of the world’s consumers and food producers. These biotech
crops include alfalfa, sugar beets, papaya, squash, eggplant, potatoes, and apples, all of which are
already in the market.

### Key references:

[Brief 54: Global Status of Commercialized Biotech/GM Crops: 2018][34]

While studies recording, demonstrating and quantifying the benefits of biotechnology are available,
they can be difficult to find. The purpose of this database is to enable you to quickly and easily
locate and access credible scientific information about the demonstrated benefits of agricultural
biotechnology products and the safety implications associated with their use.

All the papers have either been published in peer-reviewed journals or have been prepared by
organisations that have summarised peer-reviewed studies.
Papers are organised primarily by the different categories of impact of biotechnology, with links on
the left column to each impact category. Clicking on the link provides a summary and description of
the impact and a list of papers in the database that relate to the relevant impact category.

The database search allows you to further specify your filters to find the right paper of interest.
This option is interactive with the search results updating as soon as a parameter is changed.

The list of studies is being continuously added to and updated, and your suggestions for the
inclusion of additional studies are welcome via [this form][35].

# Database of the Safety and Benefits of Biotechnology

Welcome to the CropLife International database of published papers and reviews demonstrating the
benefits and safety implications associated with the use of agricultural biotechnology products.

In 2018, 26 countries grew 191.7 million hectares of biotech crops – an increase of 1.9 million
hectares from 2017. The average biotech crop adoption rate in the top five biotech crop-growing
countries increased in 2018 to reach close to saturation, with USA at 93.3% (average for soybeans,
maize, and canola adoption), Brazil (93%), Argentina (~100%), Canada (92.5%), and India (95%).
Future expansion of biotech crop areas in these countries would be through immediate approval and
commercialization of new biotech crops and traits to target problems related to climate change and
the emergence of new pests and diseases.

Biotech crops however have already expanded beyond the big four (maize, soybeans, cotton, and
canola) to give more choices for many of the world’s consumers and food producers. These biotech
crops include alfalfa, sugar beets, papaya, squash, eggplant, potatoes, and apples, all of which are
already in the market.

### Key references:

[Brief 54: Global Status of Commercialized Biotech/GM Crops: 2018][34]

While studies recording, demonstrating and quantifying the benefits of biotechnology are available,
they can be difficult to find. The purpose of this database is to enable you to quickly and easily
locate and access credible scientific information about the demonstrated benefits of agricultural
biotechnology products and the safety implications associated with their use.

All the papers have either been published in peer-reviewed journals or have been prepared by
organisations that have summarised peer-reviewed studies.
Papers are organised primarily by the different categories of impact of biotechnology, with links on
the left column to each impact category. Clicking on the link provides a summary and description of
the impact and a list of papers in the database that relate to the relevant impact category.

The database search allows you to further specify your filters to find the right paper of interest.
This option is interactive with the search results updating as soon as a parameter is changed.

The list of studies is being continuously added to and updated, and your suggestions for the
inclusion of additional studies are welcome via [this form][35].

China for over 15 years. Our company is located in Hangzhou , near Shanghai. Our manufacturing base

caused by pests, weeds and diseases, through intelligent system solutions and high-quality products.

products, specialized in the field of environment-friendly techniques and formulations. As a

# TESTING

Find out what levels of toxic chemicals
are in your body and in your food

[LEARN MORE][20]

# SOLUTIONS

New technology alternatives to toxic chemical herbicides and real detox solutions

[LEARN MORE][21]

# CERTIFICATION

Bringing real transparency on toxic chemicals
to the food and supplement industries

[LEARN MORE][22]

## As covered in:

## Testing

Test yourself and your food for pesticides cheaply and at home, using new technology developed for
The Detox Project.

[Learn more][23]

## Certification

**Glyphosate Residue Free** and **Gold Standard Detox** certification are bringing a new era of
transparency to the food and supplement industries.

[Learn more][24]

## Solutions

We are creating a support structure for new technology alternatives to chemical herbicides and to
clean herbicides from your soil.
[Learn more][25]

## Research

A unique information portal to help you understand more about the harm being caused by pesticides
and glyphosate-based herbicides worldwide
[Learn more][26]

## Reports

The Detox Project, working in coordination with partners, is testing to uncover the truth about the
levels of pesticides in many of the top-selling food and supplement products in the U.S and around
the world.
[Learn More][27]

# Green Technology Continuous Regeneration

[ Learn More >> ][278]

## Chemical Process Technology and Equipment

[Process Technology Solutions][Process Technology Solutions]

### [Process Technology Solutions][279]

We offer a one-stop solution with technical expertise and quality equipment for chemicals like
**LiFSI**, **PLA**, and **NaCN**, providing full support from selection to maintenance.

 

[LEARN MORE >>][280]

[Separation Equipment][Separation Equipment]

### [Separation Equipment ][281]

We offer separation and process equipment, including **Falling-film Evaporators, Gas-liquid
Separators, Extraction Towers, and Melt Crystallizers, as well as Structured Packings and Column
Internals.**

[LEARN MORE >>][282]

[Continuous Flow Reactor][Continuous Flow Reactor]

### [Continuous Flow Reactor][283]

We offer continuous flow reactors, including **Micro Reactors, Static Mixers **(for high-viscosity
systems)**, Polymerization Reactors, and Heat Exchangers** for polymer melts or solutions.

[LEARN MORE >>][284]

## About DODGEN

*Shanghai DODGEN Chemical Technology Co., Ltd (DODGEN) – Green Technology, Continuous Regeneration*

As a leader in chemical processing, DODGEN is dedicated to becoming a specialist in advanced
materials and sustainable process technologies. We work closely with clients across the new
materials, renewable energy, and green manufacturing sectors to drive value and success. Through
innovative technology, chemical process design, and cost-efficient solutions, DODGEN is committed to
advancing industrial technologies and seizing future growth opportunities.

[ LEARN MORE ABOUT US > ][285]
[About DODGEN][About DODGEN]

## Why Choose Chemical Process Company DODGEN

1 DODGEN has consistently focused on the development of new materials, renewable energy, and green
chemical manufacturing for clean and low-carbon industries. By integrating advanced technologies,
new processes, and equipment across the entire industrial chain, we enable the rapid
industrialization of scientific research and production.

2 DODGEN, a chemical processing company, holds multiple patents for both technologies and equipment
developed leveraging our unique advantages. Our commitment to quality, innovation, and meeting
client needs remains at the core of our mission. Through innovative R&D, we offer tailored solutions
and chemical process designs to meet the diverse needs of our customers. By developing process
technology packages, key equipment, and chemicals, these three core elements are seamlessly
integrated to deliver highly competitive and optimized process technology solutions.

3 To better serve our customers, we offer pilot testing, installation guidance, pre-commissioning
inspections, and start-up support. Our goal is to be a professional and reliable partner, working
together to ensure the successful implementation of each project.

# Green Technology Continuous Regeneration

[ Learn More >> ][278]

## Chemical Process Technology and Equipment

[Process Technology Solutions][Process Technology Solutions]

### [Process Technology Solutions][279]

We offer a one-stop solution with technical expertise and quality equipment for chemicals like
**LiFSI**, **PLA**, and **NaCN**, providing full support from selection to maintenance.

 

[LEARN MORE >>][280]

[Separation Equipment][Separation Equipment]

### [Separation Equipment ][281]

We offer separation and process equipment, including **Falling-film Evaporators, Gas-liquid
Separators, Extraction Towers, and Melt Crystallizers, as well as Structured Packings and Column
Internals.**

[LEARN MORE >>][282]

[Continuous Flow Reactor][Continuous Flow Reactor]

### [Continuous Flow Reactor][283]

We offer continuous flow reactors, including **Micro Reactors, Static Mixers **(for high-viscosity
systems)**, Polymerization Reactors, and Heat Exchangers** for polymer melts or solutions.

[LEARN MORE >>][284]

## About DODGEN

*Shanghai DODGEN Chemical Technology Co., Ltd (DODGEN) – Green Technology, Continuous Regeneration*

As a leader in chemical processing, DODGEN is dedicated to becoming a specialist in advanced
materials and sustainable process technologies. We work closely with clients across the new
materials, renewable energy, and green manufacturing sectors to drive value and success. Through
innovative technology, chemical process design, and cost-efficient solutions, DODGEN is committed to
advancing industrial technologies and seizing future growth opportunities.

[ LEARN MORE ABOUT US > ][285]
[About DODGEN][About DODGEN]

## Why Choose Chemical Process Company DODGEN

1 DODGEN has consistently focused on the development of new materials, renewable energy, and green
chemical manufacturing for clean and low-carbon industries. By integrating advanced technologies,
new processes, and equipment across the entire industrial chain, we enable the rapid
industrialization of scientific research and production.

2 DODGEN, a chemical processing company, holds multiple patents for both technologies and equipment
developed leveraging our unique advantages. Our commitment to quality, innovation, and meeting
client needs remains at the core of our mission. Through innovative R&D, we offer tailored solutions
and chemical process designs to meet the diverse needs of our customers. By developing process
technology packages, key equipment, and chemicals, these three core elements are seamlessly
integrated to deliver highly competitive and optimized process technology solutions.

3 To better serve our customers, we offer pilot testing, installation guidance, pre-commissioning
inspections, and start-up support. Our goal is to be a professional and reliable partner, working
together to ensure the successful implementation of each project.

# Satellite-Powered Smart Insights

## Earth observation insights for Mining, Agriculture, Carbon and Beyond

Mining Agriculture Product Traceability Wildfire Alerts Carbon Monitoring Finance Fleet Tracking

## Satellite Mineral Detection

We deliver **lab-validated mineral detection with over 90% accuracy**, powered by advanced satellite
analytics. Trusted across **25+ countries**, our technology helps identify mineral zones with
confidence.

[ Get Started ][31]
[ Contact Us ][32]
[ Become a Partner ][33]

## Smart Agriculture Monitoring

Monitor crop health, soil moisture, and vegetation index using satellite data. Empower farmers and
agribusinesses with real-time insights to boost productivity and sustainability.

[ Get Started ][34]
[ Learn More ][35]

## Product Traceability

Track agricultural produce from farm to shelf with our traceability solutions. Ensure food safety,
compliance, and transparency throughout the supply chain.

[ Contact Us ][36]
[ Learn More ][37]

## Wildfire Alerts

Detect and monitor wildfires in real-time with satellite-powered alerts. Reduce risk, respond
faster, and safeguard assets, ecosystems, and communities.

[ Contact Us ][38]
[ Learn More ][39]

## Carbon Monitoring

Measure, report, and verify carbon emissions and sequestration using satellite-based MRV systems.
Support climate-smart practices and carbon credit programs with accuracy.

[ Contact Us ][40]
[ Learn More ][41]

## Agri-Loan and Insurance

Make informed agri-loan decisions with satellite data insights. Evaluate field conditions, crop
patterns, and risks to enable secure, scalable, and data-backed financing.

[ Contact Us ][42]
[ Learn More ][43]

## Fleet Tracking & Management

Track and manage vehicles, machinery, and equipment in real-time. Improve route optimization, fuel
efficiency, and operational productivity with satellite-backed fleet tracking.

[ Contact Us ][44]
[ Learn More ][45]

[Why the NFU?]

### Why the NFU?

The National Farmers Union believes that farmers possess more power to shape agricultural policies,
advocate for economic and social policies, and create a stronger and more sustainable farming
community, when they work together.

Today, as farmers face the realities of climate change and rising input costs paired with shrinking
production values, the need for a collective and unified voice has never been more crucial.

### Why the NFU?

The National Farmers Union believes that farmers possess more power to shape agricultural policies,
advocate for economic and social policies, and create a stronger and more sustainable farming
community, when they work together.

Today, as farmers face the realities of climate change and rising input costs paired with shrinking
production values, the need for a collective and unified voice has never been more crucial.

# Science in Society Archive

The Science in Society website is an archive of scientific reports, journalism and audio visual
material representing two decades of work by the [Institute of Science in Society][7], the
Independent Science Panel, I-SISart and theSparc. There are close to 2000 reports available on this
site: some are previously published in print, others only electronically. The majority are available
for the first time with extra illustrations and references; this site represents a body of work
available nowhere else online or in print. Please search for documents by [category][8], use the
[search function][9], or see a list of all documents in the [sitemap][10]. Hard copies of major
reports are available [here][11], with CD-roms and DVDs available [here][12].

[I-SIS major reports]

### Major Reports

the Institute of Science in Society and the Independent Science Panel produced a number of
significant reports on the topics of Energy policy, Sustainability, Biotechnology, and the
Environment. These are all available in print form and electronically. [Banishing Glyphosate][13] |
[Ban GMOs Now][14] | [Death Camp Fukushima Chernobyl][15] | [The Case for A GM-Free Sustainable
World][16] | [Which Energy?][17] | [Food Futures Now][18] | [Green Energies][19]

[Science in Society Magazine]

### Science in Society Magazine

The influential in-house magazine of the Institute of Science in Society - "The only radical science
magazine on earth". Science in Society (formerly I-SIS News) was published between 1999 and 2016,
and was widely circulated to the public, politicians and policy makers worldwide. Reports from all
69 issues are available on this site - please examine the [SiS index][20] to see the contents of
each issue. Back issues and electronic copies are still available in the SiS online store.

[I-SIS events]

### Events

Aswell as producing scientific reports, the forementioned organisations hosted several high profile
events, including in the British and European Parliaments. These were predominantly scientific, but
also throwing art and music into the mix.

Highlights include the [Colours of Water][21] (2013), [Quantum Jazz - Biology* Medicine* Art][22]
(2011), Green Energies Launch (2009), GM Free Europe (2007), Which Energy Launch (2006), Sustainable
World Conference (2005), ISP Briefing at the European Parliament (2004) and ISP Launch (2003)

# Science in Society Archive

The Science in Society website is an archive of scientific reports, journalism and audio visual
material representing two decades of work by the [Institute of Science in Society][7], the
Independent Science Panel, I-SISart and theSparc. There are close to 2000 reports available on this
site: some are previously published in print, others only electronically. The majority are available
for the first time with extra illustrations and references; this site represents a body of work
available nowhere else online or in print. Please search for documents by [category][8], use the
[search function][9], or see a list of all documents in the [sitemap][10]. Hard copies of major
reports are available [here][11], with CD-roms and DVDs available [here][12].

[I-SIS major reports]

### Major Reports

the Institute of Science in Society and the Independent Science Panel produced a number of
significant reports on the topics of Energy policy, Sustainability, Biotechnology, and the
Environment. These are all available in print form and electronically. [Banishing Glyphosate][13] |
[Ban GMOs Now][14] | [Death Camp Fukushima Chernobyl][15] | [The Case for A GM-Free Sustainable
World][16] | [Which Energy?][17] | [Food Futures Now][18] | [Green Energies][19]

[Science in Society Magazine]

### Science in Society Magazine

The influential in-house magazine of the Institute of Science in Society - "The only radical science
magazine on earth". Science in Society (formerly I-SIS News) was published between 1999 and 2016,
and was widely circulated to the public, politicians and policy makers worldwide. Reports from all
69 issues are available on this site - please examine the [SiS index][20] to see the contents of
each issue. Back issues and electronic copies are still available in the SiS online store.

[I-SIS events]

### Events

Aswell as producing scientific reports, the forementioned organisations hosted several high profile
events, including in the British and European Parliaments. These were predominantly scientific, but
also throwing art and music into the mix.

Highlights include the [Colours of Water][21] (2013), [Quantum Jazz - Biology* Medicine* Art][22]
(2011), Green Energies Launch (2009), GM Free Europe (2007), Which Energy Launch (2006), Sustainable
World Conference (2005), ISP Briefing at the European Parliament (2004) and ISP Launch (2003)

[ Click Here ][60]

# What is glyphosate?

The profuse use of glyphosate on our crops and environment is a public health emergency. If you do
not know the details of the herbicide glyphosate, please pay attention – you are eating, drinking
and touching it all day, everyday.

More on Glyphosate... Expand

Glyphosate, the active chemical in the weedkiller product Roundup, is the most widely used pesticide
on the planet. In the US, 280 million pounds of glyphosate is sprayed on agricultural land every
year. Unfortunately, glyphosate is also linked to many devastating health conditions, including
cancer, liver disease, and infertility. Yet our regulators continue to permit its use by farmers,
landscapers, and average hardware store shoppers.

Glyphosate Facts is committed to sharing the accurate story of what is happening to humans, animals,
and our planet due to chronic exposure to glyphosate. We raise public awareness of pesticide harm,
highlight critical scientific research, and address failing pesticide policies.

## Mapping the Use of Glyphosate

Roundup Ready GMOs were introduced in 1996, launching a dramatic rise in glyphosate use. Check out
the USGS mapped data of glyphosate use over time by learning more below.

[ Learn More ][61]
[map-outline]

# Quick Facts

Glyphosate is found in our soil, water, air, rain, food, personal products, and bodies.

**Glyphosate is a mineral chelator,** meaning it binds to key minerals in the soil where our crops
are grown. As a result, our crops now lack the minerals that our bodies biologically depend upon for
health.

**Glyphosate is predominantly used as a weedkiller** in combination with “Roundup Ready” GMOs, which
are crops genetically modified to be resistant to the herbicidal effects of glyphosate.

**The agricultural chemical industry** holds a great deal of influence globally with politicians,
regulators, and academics.

**Over 80% of dietary exposure to glyphosate** is due to farmers spraying glyphosate on a crop just
prior to harvest to kill it, dry it, and thus make the harvest process easier. For decades,
pre-harvest spraying has been routine on crops including grains, sugar beets, and peas.

**Independent, peer-reviewed research** shows that glyphosate can cause cancer, endocrine
disruption, infertility, preterm birth, sperm count declines, microbiome disruption, kidney disease,
liver disease and neurological disorders.

**Glyphosate is present in many common foods,** including Cheerios, Goldfish Crackers, granola,
orange juice, Impossible Burger, hummus, and meat from animals who fed on GMO corn and soy.

# Empower Change, Donate Today

Your donation will help fund vital initiatives such as educational campaigns, impactful
documentaries, podcasts, and publications that expose the truth about glyphosate. With your support,
we can create a world where clean, toxin-free food is the norm, not the exception.

# What is glyphosate?

The profuse use of glyphosate on our crops and environment is a public health emergency. If you do
not know the details of the herbicide glyphosate, please pay attention – you are eating, drinking
and touching it all day, everyday.

More on Glyphosate... Expand

Glyphosate, the active chemical in the weedkiller product Roundup, is the most widely used pesticide
on the planet. In the US, 280 million pounds of glyphosate is sprayed on agricultural land every
year. Unfortunately, glyphosate is also linked to many devastating health conditions, including
cancer, liver disease, and infertility. Yet our regulators continue to permit its use by farmers,
landscapers, and average hardware store shoppers.

Glyphosate Facts is committed to sharing the accurate story of what is happening to humans, animals,
and our planet due to chronic exposure to glyphosate. We raise public awareness of pesticide harm,
highlight critical scientific research, and address failing pesticide policies.

## Mapping the Use of Glyphosate

Roundup Ready GMOs were introduced in 1996, launching a dramatic rise in glyphosate use. Check out
the USGS mapped data of glyphosate use over time by learning more below.

[ Learn More ][61]
[map-outline]

# Quick Facts

Glyphosate is found in our soil, water, air, rain, food, personal products, and bodies.

**Glyphosate is a mineral chelator,** meaning it binds to key minerals in the soil where our crops
are grown. As a result, our crops now lack the minerals that our bodies biologically depend upon for
health.

**Glyphosate is predominantly used as a weedkiller** in combination with “Roundup Ready” GMOs, which
are crops genetically modified to be resistant to the herbicidal effects of glyphosate.

**The agricultural chemical industry** holds a great deal of influence globally with politicians,
regulators, and academics.

**Over 80% of dietary exposure to glyphosate** is due to farmers spraying glyphosate on a crop just
prior to harvest to kill it, dry it, and thus make the harvest process easier. For decades,
pre-harvest spraying has been routine on crops including grains, sugar beets, and peas.

**Independent, peer-reviewed research** shows that glyphosate can cause cancer, endocrine
disruption, infertility, preterm birth, sperm count declines, microbiome disruption, kidney disease,
liver disease and neurological disorders.

**Glyphosate is present in many common foods,** including Cheerios, Goldfish Crackers, granola,
orange juice, Impossible Burger, hummus, and meat from animals who fed on GMO corn and soy.

Your donation will help fund vital initiatives such as educational campaigns, impactful

we can create a world where clean, toxin-free food is the norm, not the exception.

## לידור אלמנטס

היא אחת החברות המובילות בישראל ליישום חומרים, מוצרים וטכנולוגיות בתחומי התעשיה והגנת הצומח. מזה 50
שנה, אנו מלווים חברות רבות בישראל, מהגדולות במשק ועד מיזמים ראשוניים, מייעצים במסירות ומספקים
פתרונות לצרכיהן ואתגריהן. אנו מייבאים, מוכרים ומפיצים חומרים ומוצרים באיכות הגבוהה ביותר, לרבות
פתרונות טכנולוגיים מתקדמים המשפרים יעילות ומסייעים ביצירת עתיד בר-קיימא. לספקינו הבינלאומיים, אנו
מציעים שירותים עסקיים נרחבים, פתרונות לוגיסטיים מקצה לקצה ותמיכה רגולטורית מלאה.

## לידור אלמנטס

היא אחת החברות המובילות בישראל ליישום חומרים, מוצרים וטכנולוגיות בתחומי התעשיה והגנת הצומח. מזה 50
שנה, אנו מלווים חברות רבות בישראל, מהגדולות במשק ועד מיזמים ראשוניים, מייעצים במסירות ומספקים
פתרונות לצרכיהן ואתגריהן. אנו מייבאים, מוכרים ומפיצים חומרים ומוצרים באיכות הגבוהה ביותר, לרבות
פתרונות טכנולוגיים מתקדמים המשפרים יעילות ומסייעים ביצירת עתיד בר-קיימא. לספקינו הבינלאומיים, אנו
מציעים שירותים עסקיים נרחבים, פתרונות לוגיסטיים מקצה לקצה ותמיכה רגולטורית מלאה.

[ Contact Us ][95]

### What test do I need?

When in doubt, start with a [Core Kit][96] to analyze multiple contaminants with a single test. If
you have more specific motivations for testing, try our [Customize My Kit][97] feature to match your
needs to the right test(s).

### Are Tap Score labs certified?

Yes. All labs we use in the SimpleLab Network are certified to the ISO/IEC 17025 standards. This
means results are reliable and accurate.

Need a specific certification? Let us know so that we can meet your needs accordingly. 

[Learn more][98]

### What’s the turnaround time?

Most people receive results within 3-5 business days after the lab receives their sample. However,
some tests may require additional analytical time so be sure to check each kit’s product page for
the most accurate estimate.

### What does my report include?

Your report will rank your water against local and federal safety benchmarks, provide a thorough
breakdown of any contaminants detected and how they may be affecting your health or plumbing, and
provide non-biased treatment recommendations.

## Have questions? We have answers.

Reach out to us any time. We can help with everything related to water testing, including:
* Test Kit Selection
* Lab Methods & Certifications
* Detection & Reporting Limits

[ Contact Us ][95]

### What test do I need?

When in doubt, start with a [Core Kit][96] to analyze multiple contaminants with a single test. If
you have more specific motivations for testing, try our [Customize My Kit][97] feature to match your
needs to the right test(s).

### Are Tap Score labs certified?

Yes. All labs we use in the SimpleLab Network are certified to the ISO/IEC 17025 standards. This
means results are reliable and accurate.

Need a specific certification? Let us know so that we can meet your needs accordingly. 

[Learn more][98]

### What’s the turnaround time?

Most people receive results within 3-5 business days after the lab receives their sample. However,
some tests may require additional analytical time so be sure to check each kit’s product page for
the most accurate estimate.

### What does my report include?

Your report will rank your water against local and federal safety benchmarks, provide a thorough
breakdown of any contaminants detected and how they may be affecting your health or plumbing, and
provide non-biased treatment recommendations.
